name: Onboarding Tour opens from the sidebar and shows the five-section skeleton
description: From the PR list, open the WORKSPACE sidebar's 'Onboarding Tour' entry, land on /repos/<active>/tour, and confirm the heading and the five section titles render. The seeded demo repo (acme/payments-api) has no clone (server/src/db/seed.ts), so the server answers with the deterministic no-clone skeleton and the 'Not cloned — clone to generate' status line: no model call is possible, and no step presses 'Generate tour'. The 'No API key …' line may also show below it depending on the environment's secrets; the flow does not assert on it. Covers AC-01, AC-02, AC-07, AC-82 (L05 Onboarding Generator). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: tall viewport: agent-browser does not scroll before a click, and the sections run below the first screen
land on the PR list of the active repo
open the Onboarding Tour entry in the WORKSPACE sidebar
navigate to the repo's tour route
the heading names the active repo
the skeleton path was taken: the repo is not cloned, so no generation is possible
